info.title: fmstudio - toolkit for Factorio mod developers
info.description: Command-line toolkit for Factorio mod developers: validate, pack, run profiles, analyze logs, smoke-test.

commands.name: add
commands.description:
Add a building block (armor, enemy, belt tier, assembler, car, ...) to the project mod
[--title T] [--dry-run] [--json]   `add --list` shows the blocks; name: <mod>-<block>
Writes prototypes/<name>.lua and appends to data.lua and locale/en; never overwrites

commands.name: factorio
commands.description: List the Factorio installations found and the one chosen for the project's mod  [--json]

commands.name: available
commands.description: Factorio's headless server releases (Linux x64)  [--all] [--json]

options.name: --factorio
options.description:
Factorio executable or install folder for run/smoke. Without it, the installation whose version
matches the mod's factorio_version is chosen automatically from FACTORIO_PATH, "factorioPath" in
fmstudio.json, those added in the UI and the usual folders (see `fmstudio factorio`)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 problems found, 2 usage or configuration error.

commands.name: add
commands.description:

commands.name: factorio
commands.description: List the Factorio installations found and the one chosen for the project's mod  [--json]

commands.name: install
remove
commands.description: Delete a release installed with `factorio install`

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create fmstudio.json in the project folder

commands.name: log
commands.description: Summarize errors/warnings from a Factorio log  [--json] [--verbose]

commands.name: new
commands.description:
Create a mod from a template (empty, item-recipe, entity, runtime-script)
[--template <id>] [--title T] [--author A] [--description D] [--factorio-version <MAJOR.MINOR, default 2.0>]
[--content block,block: building blocks to add right away (Factorio 2.0+)]
[--out <folder, default: the workspace>] [--json]   `new --list` shows the templates

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Validate and build NAME_VERSION.zip   [--out dir] [--force]

commands.name: prepare
commands.description: Build the isolated mods folder for a profile

commands.name: run
commands.description: Prepare a profile and start Factorio with it

commands.name: smoke
commands.description:
Headless test: load the mods, simulate ticks, fail on log errors
[--ticks N] [--seed N] [--timeout MINUTES] [--json]
[--install: no matching Factorio? download the headless server first (Linux)]

commands.name: ui
commands.description:
Open the graphical mod browser in your web browser
[--port N] [--workspace <mods folder to edit>] [--mods <installed mods, read-only>]
[--no-browser]

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Check info.json, changelog, thumbnail and file references
